args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production. Rollback verified in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. Checked status: `v2.3.1` was unhealthy in all regions (error rate 0.18).
2. Reviewed deployment history: the most recent healthy production release was `v2.3.0` (v2.3.1 was unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc was staging only).
3. Rolled back to `v2.3.0` in all regions — verified rolled out in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
4. Opened SEV2 incident `INC-0001` describing the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer.
